purpose: Exercise the actual transactional recovery-gap path under a deliberately stalled AI RPC. A forced NeuralRx failure on the first timed request opens a 43 ms fallback interval; the first AI work unit responds only after 60 ms. Compare a 45 ms socket timeout that exceeds its 30 ms host lease with a 25 ms timeout inside the lease, using the same input and MPS epoch.

execution.operational_requalification: 200 clean conventional-only releases with zero deadline misses

interpretation_limit: This is an injected boundary violation diagnostic, not an expected pass of the old 45 ms contract. The first-run delay may also depend on OS scheduling. A timely fallback with a 25 ms socket timeout does not by itself prove arbitrary GPU-work cancellation or WCET; the stalled AI worker can remain active until its own response is attempted. Keep previous unperturbed results unchanged.
